properties.comment:
The project was launched in General Santos City/Sarangani Province in 2008 as a joint venture between a local firm (SAFI Agro Industries, Inc.) and foreign partners from Japan and South Korea Initial activities centered in Maasim town (Barangay Siguel) for a 100 ha pilot plantation.

An oil extraction and biodiesel processing facility was established at Barangay Bawing, General Santos City (on a 6.8 ha site, formerly London Beach Resort)  to process jatropha seed oil. The broader target cultivation area spanned up to 50,000 ha across Sarangani Province , with plans later expanding to as much as 100,000 ha in the General Santos/Sarangani region.

properties.name: Mount Mantalingajan, Rizal, Palawan, Philippines
properties.description: The project is located in Southern Palawan, encompassing five municipalities: Quezon, Jose Rizal, Bataraza, Brooke's Point, and Sofronio Española. The project area covers a total of 149,109 hectares, including the Mount Mantalingahan Protected Landscape (MMPL) and surrounding ancestral domains of the Indigenous Palaw’an communities. Prior to the project, the area faced significant threats from deforestation and forest degradation due to unsustainable agricultural expansion, illegal logging, mining, and encroachment on ancestral lands. These activities led to substantial loss of forest cover, biodiversity, and carbon stocks, contributing to increased GHG emissions and reduced ecosystem services essential for the livelihoods of local communities.
properties.facility_name: Supporting Ancestral Domains: Carbon Finance for Climate Action and Sustainable Development in the Mount Mantalingahan Protected Landscape

properties.name: Imugan Falls, Santa Fe, Nueva Vizcaya, Philippines
properties.comment: This was an attempted Exploration mining project initiated by Titan Mining Corporation, which is reportedly owned by Chinese individuals/incheck. The application was filed around 2010 or 2011. The company obtained an Exploration Permit (EP0000181I) from the DENR/MGB Regional Office, despite the process being flawed, lacking proper Free, Prior, and Informed Consent (FPIC). The community discovered the permit and sought a congressional investigation. The permit was ultimately canceled by the Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB) due to TMEC’s failure to submit the required NCIP Certification Precondition.
properties.description: The project site was located within the Ikalahan ancestral domain, specifically identified as a reserve area and overlapping with the Ikalahan Community Conserved Area and Territory (ICCA). This area is crucial as a water seed and head water of the tributaries of the Magat River, extending to the Cagayan River. It is characterized by mountainous terrain with high levels of biodiversity, montane forests, and is considered a Forest Reserve for watershed and wildlife protection.
properties.facility_name: Titan Mining and Energy Corporation (TMEC) Exploration Permit EP0000181I (Titan Mining Company)
